metadata.timing: Per-operation latency includes actor context setup, Prisma pool acquisition, business mutation, optional audit and transaction commit; payload allocation, seed inserts, correctness queries and cleanup are excluded. Throughput uses measured batch wall time, not summed latency. Each block preserves measured latenciesMs in completion order, excluding warmups.
metadata.payloadDefinition: 64k means the manual metadata.payload string is at least 65536 UTF-8 bytes, not 65536 characters. Blocks record exact payload string and complete input metadata JSON sizes in both UTF-8 bytes and UTF-16 code units.
metadata.order: Manual control runs first; baseline/candidate order alternates every repeat. Automatic operation order is create/update/delete and library order alternates every repeat.
metadata.limits: One shared host/process/client; audit rows accumulate. Repeats, warm caches, database growth and runner scheduling can affect paired observations. No statistical significance or production throughput claim. P99 is sensitive at this sample count.
